title: Membership Tenure Bonus Schedule — Earned Pals Rewards Tiers
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** When an earned free tier is applied, a tenure bonus is added according to the full calendar months the membership has been enrolled, counted from its enrollment date.

| Months enrolled | Tenure bonus |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 100 points |
| 24 to 59 | 50 points |
| fewer than 24 | none |

**Edges (hypothetical enrollment dates, applied on 10 March 2026).**

| Enrollment date | Full months enrolled | Tenure bonus |
|---|---|---|
| 10 March 2021 | 60 | 100 |
| 11 March 2021 | 59 | 50 |
| 10 March 2024 | 24 | 50 |
| 11 March 2024 | 23 | none |
